name: 85653 · Marana, AZ
findings: ZIP 85653 (Marana) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85653 (Marana) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85653 (Marana) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
